description.value: FARO is a café and coastal Italian restaurant within Victoria's Oak Bay Beach Hotel, named after the Italian word for 'beacon' or 'lighthouse.' By morning it serves handcrafted barista coffee and fresh-baked pastries; by afternoon and evening it shifts to Neapolitan-style pizzas from a Wood Stone oven, seasonal share plates, and a curated wine list. Cyclists can dine indoors or relax on the outdoor patio beside signature fire features, with dogs welcome outside.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content confirms FARO is an active café and full-service restaurant inside the Oak Bay Beach Hotel, serving barista coffee and pastries by day and coastal Italian/Neapolitan pizza by evening. The site explicitly states takeaway is available and the outdoor patio is dog-friendly. No bike-specific infrastructure (racks, storage, pump, e-bike charging) is mentioned anywhere in the website or OSM tags; washrooms are confirmed via the hotel FAQ which describes accessible washrooms on the main floor accessible to restaurant guests.
concerns: OSM record has no address or phone; address was truncated in the fetched contact page and could not be confirmed. Phone number extracted from group-dining context on the website — may not be the main reservations line.
OSM tags are sparse (only amenity=cafe and name); no supplementary tags to cross-check amenities against.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: FARO is a legitimate, active café and restaurant in Oak Bay that would serve touring cyclists well, offering takeaway, accessible washrooms, and a welcoming patio. Bike parking infrastructure is unconfirmed and should be verified on-site.
enrichment_extras.notes: The phone number 1-250-940-0309 appears on the website specifically for group reservations of 6+ guests; the main hotel contact number may differ. Address should be confirmed as 1175 Beach Dr, Oak Bay, Victoria, BC when verifying the listing.

wow_evidence: takeaway is available and the outdoor patio is dog-friendly; accessible washrooms on main floor
